summary.text: Christopher J. Kessler, a Democrat, represents House District 121 (Cape Elizabeth and South Portland, Cumberland County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in South Portland. The House profile lists membership on the Energy, Utilities and Technology Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives energy auditor as the occupation and a B.A. (2005) as the degree, and lists the Maine Climate Council as an affiliation.
It lists Kessler's marital status as married.
